A '''squadron''' of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] was a unit of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was under the command of [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone Sergeant]] [[Banks (clone)|Banks]].

==History==
{{Quote|7719&mdash;your team is to slip in, confirm this command center's presence, and, if possible, ''disable'' it.|[[Griebs Kishpaugh]], to [[Banks (clone)|Banks]]|<ref name="TEW" />}}
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], this [[Squad/Legends|squad]] was involved in a [[Mission to Oznek|mission]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Oznek]].<ref name="TEW" />
